data.name: Loopback Marketplace
data.description: Feature-driven multi-role marketplace platform with escrow transactions via Stripe Connect, robust authentication, and comprehensive role-based authorization. Built with React, Vite, TypeScript, Express, Prisma, and Swagger UI.

data.name: Software Agency Platform
data.description: Modern high-converting digital software agency web platform with responsive animated UI, service showcases, interactive client flows, and dynamic lead capture. Built with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, and Vite.

data.name: ChatBot AI API Endpoint & Portal
data.description: Serverless Vercel chat API endpoint and portal engineered to integrate into any existing chat widget. Performs knowledge base search, TF-IDF keyword tokenization, and multi-format structured response synthesis with MongoDB persistence.

data.name: DevSync File Sync & Backup
data.description: Cross-platform real-time file synchronization and backup platform with workspace sync, conflict resolution, and transfer monitoring. Designed a TypeScript monorepo integrating Electron desktop client, Node.js/Express backend, CLI, and Docker containerization with Caddy.

data.name: Multi-Tenant Payment System
data.description: Event-driven multi-tenant payment infrastructure with 12 microservices supporting merchant management, multi-gateway payments, subscriptions, refunds, and HMAC-secured webhooks. Uses RabbitMQ events/RPC, Redis idempotency, and Node.js SDK.

data.name: DayFlow AI Business Assistant
data.description: Multi-tenant AI business assistant empowering SMEs with WhatsApp automated business insights. Integrated Gemini AI with Google Sheets, Notion, and Airtable for contextual analytics, tenant isolation, audio transcription, and PDF reporting.

data.name: ScaleForge B2B Sales Automation
data.description: High-performance B2B sales automation and CRM platform. Features centralized lead management, automated outreach via decoupled bot workers (Gmail/OAuth2), and persistent state with Upstash Redis. Built with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Node.js/Express.
